This marked Anderson’s first-ever Academy Award win, a milestone in his long and acclaimed career as a filmmaker. The film is an adaptation of Thomas Pynchon’s novel Vineland and was widely praised for its screenplay, which successfully translated the novel’s complex narrative and themes to the screen.
